no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Streamex Corp. is now primarily a tokenization / digital-asset infrastructure company (Streamex Exchange, GLDY tokenized gold). The legacy biomedical line is the FDA-cleared, commercially marketed PURE EP cardiac signal-processing platform. The only historical drug program (merimepodib via majority-owned ViralClear) was discontinued in late 2020 and ViralClear is dormant. No active P1/P2/P3 drug or device IDE trials disclosed.
